name: NEET-UG (Medical Entrance Exam)
summary: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for admission to MBBS, BDS, AYUSH, and other undergraduate medical courses across India.
eligibility: Completed or appearing in Class 12 (10+2) with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
Minimum 50% aggregate for General category; 45% for General-PwD; 40% for SC/ST/OBC and Reserved-PwD
Age between 17 and 25 years as of 31 December of the admission year (upper limit relaxed for reserved categories at some institutions)
documents: Passport-size photograph and signature per NTA specification
fee: ₹1,700 for General category (India centre); ₹1,000 for SC/ST/PwBD/Third Gender; ₹9,500 for centres outside India, regardless of category.
process: Fill the application form, upload photo/signature, and pay the fee online
Download the admit card closer to the exam date
Appear for the pen-and-paper exam (Physics, Chemistry, Biology)
Result and All India Rank released; counselling conducted separately by MCC/state authorities

faq.question: Is there an age limit for NEET-UG?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 17 and 25 years as of 31 December of the admission year, though some states/quotas apply relaxed upper limits — check the current year's information bulletin.

faq.question: Does NEET have negotiable minimum marks?
faq.answer: No — minimum qualifying percentile is fixed by category: 50th percentile for General, 45th for General-PwD, and 40th for SC/ST/OBC and Reserved-PwD candidates.
